title: AION 2 Map: Gathering Resources and 3D Routes
description: Filter AION 2 gathering maps by resource, find cave nodes and heights, plan compact routes, and export collection progress.
summary: Find one resource with Aion2T filters; use Aion2Maps for cave access and height. Select your faction’s zone and back up progress before changing browsers.
quickAnswer: For a gathering map, select your zone in Aion2T, use Hide All and enable only the resource needed. Use Aion2Maps for cave height, floor slices and exporting collection progress.
